Seagrass transect frequency of occurrence outcome by bay segment and year

Source: R/anlz_hab_seagrass_transect.R
anlz_hab_seagrass_transect.Rd

Seagrass transect frequency of occurrence outcome by bay segment and year

Usage

anlz_hab_seagrass_transect(transect)

Arguments

transect

data.frame of raw seagrass transect data, e.g. tbeptools::transect

Value

A data.frame with columns bay_segment, yr, foest (frequency of occurrence estimate, 0-100), and outcome (0-1, 1 = best)

Details

Uses anlz_transectocc and anlz_transectave to estimate frequency of seagrass occurrence (foest, 0-100) at each bay segment/year, drops the bay-wide "All" aggregate row, then converts to a 0-1 outcome with util_outcome (type = "continuous", from = c(0, 100)).

Examples

anlz_hab_seagrass_transect(tbeptools::transect)
#> # A tibble: 140 × 4
#> # Groups:   bay_segment [5]
#>    bay_segment    yr foest outcome
#>    <chr>       <dbl> <dbl>   <dbl>
#>  1 OTB          1998  65.5   0.655
#>  2 HB           1998  15.0   0.150
#>  3 MTB          1998  53.7   0.537
#>  4 LTB          1998  80.8   0.808
#>  5 BCB          1998  81.0   0.810
#>  6 OTB          1999  64.7   0.647
#>  7 HB           1999  10.1   0.101
#>  8 MTB          1999  51.8   0.518
#>  9 LTB          1999  67.5   0.675
#> 10 BCB          1999  71.0   0.710
#> # ℹ 130 more rows
